needed.evidence: The left side of the road is bounded by a concrete barrier with no footway or path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Install a signalised pedestrian crossing with a refuge island at the nearest junction to provide a safe crossing point.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road has a grassy shoulder and a separate slip road, but no dedicated footway for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Provide a signalised crossing with a refuge island at the junction with the slip road to allow safe pedestrian access.

needed.evidence: There is no visible pedestrian crossing facility on this stretch of the motorway.
needed.suggestion: Construct a grade-separated footbridge or a signalised crossing at a safe location to meet pedestrian crossing demand.

needed.evidence: The road has only a few street lights, which is not ample for a motorway.
needed.suggestion: Increase the density of street lighting along the motorway to improve visibility and safety for all road users.
